content_units: All four participants overlap only in two windows after the 09:30 start rule:

Because the two meetings need   45 min + 30 min   with   at least 60 minutes between them  , both meetings   cannot fit inside a single shared overlap block  , but they   can fit across the morning and afternoon shared windows  .
Option   Meeting   Time   Duration   Why it works
Best   Project check-in   10:00-10:45   45 min   Uses the morning overlap cleanly and leaves buffer before noon
Best   Hiring debrief   15:00-15:30   30 min   Fits the afternoon overlap; gap from prior meeting is 4h 15m
Backup   Hiring debrief   10:00-10:30   30 min   Shorter meeting first if hiring decisions are more urgent
Backup   Project check-in   15:00-15:45   45 min   Uses the afternoon overlap with a large gap from the morning slot
Why this is the best fit:
- Puts the longer meeting first, when calendars are typically fresher.
- Preserves a strong separation between operational project work and hiring discussion.
- the hiring topic is more time-sensitive
- you want the afternoon for the longer discussion
- Availability intervals were treated as inclusive working windows in   Europe/London  .
- Meetings were scheduled for   all four attendees   only.
There are no other valid all-attendee start times because:
- The required 60-minute separation makes same-block sequencing impossible
